protocol.base: daily SMA10/40; bear after 2 days, restore after 1 day; active 1.5X, bear 0X
protocol.funding_gate: latest known funding > 0.01% reduces active 1.5X to 1X
protocol.confirmation: enter/exit counts are consecutive Funding events (normally 8h), not 15m bars
protocol.execution: completed UTC daily signal; next 15m open
protocol.costs: default 10+5 bps, moderate 20+10 bps, stress 50+25 bps per side
protocol.hard_cap: 2.5X opening control and <=3X observed effective leverage
protocol.selection: worst Research/Validation excess across all three costs; OOS excluded
